name: vsco
description: Connect your existing VSCO account. Access follows the VSCO One plan on that account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your VSCO account to see a daily dashboard of tasks, bookings, invoices, and unread client email; check open leads and invoices; and look up jobs, contacts, and calendar events. When you ask, it can also make supported changes, such as adding a contact. What you can see and change follows your VSCO account permissions. Sign-in uses your existing VSCO account, and access follows the VSCO One plan on that account.
defaultPrompt: Show me my open leads in VSCO
Show me my open invoices in VSCO
